title: CrisisNews: A Dataset Mapping Two Decades of News Articles on Online Problematic Behavior at Scale
reasoning: The paper classifies and analyzes 'online problematic behaviors' and 'online harm,' including hate speech, harassment, and extremism. It utilizes a taxonomy of 'Abuse Types' to evaluate ethical breaches in digital spaces and specifically discusses concepts like 'Broken Harmony' which are explicitly linked to societal and cultural moral values.
